method: Re-chart the frozen mesh by original body region, material and facing direction, using angle-based unwrap and explicit isolation of measured conflicting UV triangles. Bake generated material surface pixels by object-space triplanar sampling. No concept-view ornament, visor, seam, roundel or emblem projection.
region_policy: Complete source faces carry one material label. Bake samples inherit face_labels[face_ids]. Textile is limited to whole faces within a narrow recessed collar; fused arms stay steel. This finite method failed visual QA due to jagged source face boundaries.
invariants: Frozen 7999 source vertices, 15998 triangles, original skin weights and four-second animation
Original-only texture, mesh, rig and motion sources
No invented texture pixels; deterministic sampling and padding only
limits: Surface color remains generated art rather than measured albedo
Roughness and metallic values are authored approximations
This does not repair fused plates, chest relief or full-body topology
qa_gates: Pin generated sources and frozen geometry hashes
Meaningful sampling and region regression tests
Same-camera front/side/back and turning views show no duplicate motifs, cross-plate black bands or UV seams
Blender evaluated motion unchanged and actual Three.js skinning matches sampled poses
Desktop/mobile preview and visible animation pixel checks

decision.initial_candidate: rejected: misplaced textile on helmet/arms and rectangular collar
decision.whole_region_correction: rejected: fragmented collar faces and triangle-stepped brass trim
decision.next: Stop mask threshold revisions. Rebuild original segmented armor and collar surfaces with deliberate material boundaries before applying the reusable original surface tiles.
